summary.cause: Not a held-out or out-of-range input (variant standard, 0 features outside the training range). The model saw a small transfer (6,662.49) that was not large for this sender (smaller than its earlier maximum, +2.3 SD) into a receiver that already had many outgoing transfers, at midday. Log-odds -1.971163 vs -1.744129 needed (short by 0.227034).
summary.rules: No fixed rule can fire: every rule has a minimum amount of 10,000 or 25,000, or needs a burst/recent inflow. An uncorroborated AMOUNT_ABOVE_OWN_HISTORY flag on a 10,795.53 merchant payment was the only trace seed and pre-empted the 'five largest outgoing' fallback, in which this transfer ranks second.
summary.threshold: On validation, moving from the selected threshold 0.0013016 to 0.000978 adds 40 false positives and 0 true positives; precision falls to 0.4897 (below the 50% target). Post-hoc cold ledger: +93 FP, +5 TP, recall +0.0038. Post-hoc engine counterfactual: the victim is flagged but none of the 3 other victims is surfaced (the intermediary is assessed unknown_role).
summary.served_threshold_rounding: metadata.json stores the selected threshold rounded up to 6 decimals; at the rounded value one validation positive (the one at exactly the selected score) falls below it, so served validation counts are tp 285 / fn 12 instead of the documented 286 / 11. Cold, temporal and served-ledger figures are unaffected. Reported only; nothing changed.

recommendation: Keep the validation-selected threshold. The alternative fails the documented precision target on validation and gains no validation positives; it would not have surfaced the other victims in this case either.
Closest-unflagged context panel: TX-303-0064858 is already the first entry (75.1% of the threshold) in the served report; it is context, never a flag or a trace seed.

Analyst-initiated trace from a chosen transfer (not available on the dynamic endpoint today; it would be a product change): labelled as analyst-selected, never as a model flag, and no automatic action.
Seed selection (owner decision, not changed): where the model is validated, a rule flag the model does not corroborate still replaces the five-largest fallback seeds.

Cross-case linkage: of the other victims' transfers into the same receiver, the model flags TX-303-0065870 (0.9148), TX-303-0066428 (0.1840); investigating either of those victims reaches the shared receiver.

Any model-side change (e.g. receiver-side features for many first-time senders paying large shares of their balance) must be trained and selected on train/validation only and scored once on the test ledgers.
